name: fpl-hsmem
description: Long-term memory across sessions for Claude Code, wrapping a Hindsight 0.10 server. Project-only and opt-in — inert unless a .hindsight.json (url, banks allowlist, defaultBank, tokenFile/tokenCommand) is found above the working directory; never derives or creates a bank. 28 MCP tools (the 27 existing tools with the same names, each bank-scoped tool takes an optional `bank`, plus memory_retain_batch) let an agent search memory, browse it by structured filter, correct a wrong fact without destroying the record, see which background jobs failed, and write a reviewed file of distilled items (decisions, rejected options, lessons) across banks with secret scanning and a dry run. Auto-recall and transcript capture are off unless the project turns them on. Ships 3 hooks, 10 skills (status, bootstrap, mental-model, diagnose, export-bank, correct-memory, audit-bank, directives, memory-setup, enrich) and the memory-curator agent.
